svg.aria-label: Adapter decision tree: a deep knowledge change with the hardware to match means a full fine-tune; otherwise, if the model fits your GPU at 16-bit use peft.adapter lora, and if it does not fit use qlora, which loads the base in 4-bit so an 8B model fits in 24 GB.
svg.title: Adapter decision tree: a deep knowledge change with the hardware to match means a full fine-tune; otherwise, if the model fits your GPU at 16-bit use peft.adapter lora, and if it does not fit use qlora, which loads the base in 4-bit so an 8B model fits in 24 GB.
